new_interesting_lines: ''It is with a heavy heart that we announce that we will be ending support for Transformers: Forged to Fight and shutting down all servers on January 13, 2023. Working on this game has been nothing less than a labor of love. We created this game for all fans of Transformers to enjoy, and as fans ourselves, we’ve loved every minute of it and have been honored by every fight, Raid, and Mission that you have completed. Although The Fight is coming to a close, we want to thank you for your dedication, support and love that you have shown this game. It has meant the world to us. As of today, we will be disabling all In-App Purchases (purchases that cost real money). But, The Fight is not over! While the adventures on New Quintessa may be coming to an end, new stories will continue to be released into December! Thank you once again for your commitment to Transformers: Forged to Fight. If you have any questions, you can reach out to our support team via the in-game menu.''
''With all our gratitude, The Transformers: Forged to Fight team.''

===Version 0.3 (March 1)===
Official Release Notes

'''New Modes for Your Alliance!'''
*Alliance Missions Coming Soon! Use strategy and cooperation as your Alliance breaks into Battlegroups to tackle difficulty Missions for fantastic rewards! More information will be available on those as we get closer to their launch.
*Alliance Events: Take on Alliances from around the world, scoring points in a variety of timed events. Earn Rank and Milestone rewards for your efforts! More information here: http://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/85/introducing-alliance-events/p1?new=1

'''New Features for You:'''
*Auto Fight: Let your Bots battle for you in Story and Daily Missions!

'''New Content:'''
*Story Missions: A new Chapter of Act 2 is available to explore!

'''Various other Changes and Improvements:'''
*Fight Introductions: New animations play when Bots enter the battle.
*Raid Rewards: Earn bonus rewards when winning Raids based on your Medal count
*Bug fixes, screen improvements, new tutorials, and optimizations

=== Version 0.2.0 (January 28, 2017) ===
Official Release Notes

'''Introducing Away Team Missions:'''
*Send your Bots on missions to collect resources
*These missions can be done while you are away and don't require you to play them

'''Introducing Synergies'''
*Pair specific Bots to activate bonus attributes and abilities.
*Strategically build your teams to maximize and customize these abilities to your play style and the challenge ahead!

New story missions have been added to help you unravel the mystery of this strange planet where realities collide.

Autobot Ratchet has been hard at work performing standard maintenance and fixing some major gameplay bugs.
== Global Launch and 2017 Updates ==
=== Version 1.0 - '''Global Launch''' ===
[[File:TF2F_SplashScreen_1.0.png|center|400x400px]]
<center>'''Global Release Date: April 28, 2017'''</center>

====Version 1.0 (April 1)====
=====Official Release Notes=====
* New Languages - Support for Japanese, Korean, Thai, Indonesian, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Norwegian, Russian, Dutch, Turkish, and Arabic.
* New Bots - [[Mixmaster]] has been added to the Premium Bot [[Crystal]]
* New Story Missions - Act 2 Chapter 4 unlocked for you to explore.
* New Event Missions - Celebrate the launch of the game with a set of 6 Boss challenges available for a limited time only! A new challenge will be released every 3 days, but hurry! They disappear on April 24th!
**[[Rulers of Kaon]] is a new challenge for the strongest Commanders to test their strength. This Mission is the first story in the new Legends of Cybertron series.
*New Daily Missions
**Introducing new Spark Trials daily Event Missions! Earn T1 Basic Sparks and Essence from Easy difficulty, and T2 Basic Sparks and Essence from Medium difficulty. Progress and rewards reset Daily.
*New Alliance Missions
**Play through cooperative Missions with your Alliance!
**The new Forgotten Ruins map features 10 difficulty levels and is an introductory map acting as a precursor to Shattered Lands.
*General
**Mission crystals have been replaced with direct ORE-13 payouts.
**The third team slot is now unlocked at level 1 (down from 3).
**Daily Missions now unlock at level 8 (up from 4).
**Raids now unlock at level 7 (up from 6).
**Raid store is locked until 7 to prevent buying items you can't use.
**Improved early game tutorialization.
**Reduced the T2 Class Spark Essence awarded for selling T1 Class Sparks
**Reduced the T2 Class Spark Essence obtained from completing the Medium Difficulty of Class Specific Daily Missions

'''Bug Fixes and Optimizations'''
*Fixed an issue that would cause Shields to expire prematurely
*Alliance Mission link nodes visibility and sync quality improved
*Fixed an issue where characters recovered from a Light Ranged combo too quickly
*Fixed numerous Crash and Connection issues
*Fixed an issue causing a hang on loading screens
*Fixed an issue causing fights in Alliance Missions to not load
*Fixed an issue where node numbers were not displaying in Alliance Missions
*Fixed an issue where a black bar will appear on top of the screen and remain there on all screens
*Miscellaneous other bug fixes and optimizations.

'''Game Balance'''
*Bot Ability Rating
**We’ve updated all Bot Ratings to more accurately reflect the overall strength of that Bot. As a result, the total Rating for all Bots has decreased. Specifically, the Rating assigned to each Bot Ability has been reduced while the Rating from base attributes remains the same. This is a display-only change that affects every Bot and will result in more accurate and reliable Bot Ratings going forward without having any effect on the actual performance of each Bot.
*Light Ranged Attacks
**Decreased damage and Power generated to be on par with Light Melee attacks
*Arcee
**Added a passive chance to automatically Sidestep incoming Ranged Attacks
**Added Bleed on Critical Hits on her Special Attack 2
**Increased damage on Headshots and limited the Bleed stack to 1
**Increased strength of her Ranged Buff on Special Attack 1
**Precision ability added as her Signature Ability as a scalable chance to activate on Special Attacks for a long duration
*Barricade
**Increased Backfire damage on Ranks 1 to 4
**Increased chance to deal Backfire.
**Evade after Knocking him down will also activate against Ranged Attacks.
*Bludgeon
**Stun chance on Special 2 and 3 will now scale by Rank
**Decreased the chance to activate Armor Buffs when struck by a Critical Hit
**Removed current Signature Ability and replaced it with his Critical Damage basic ability
*Mirage
**Mirage’s Ranged Attacks now decrease the opponent’s Power Flow just when in his Special 1“Disruption” mode
**Special 2 “Incapacitation” mode: Increased amount of Attack Debuffs required to trigger a Stun from 5 to 7
**Improved in-game ability icon clarity when his Signature Ability is active
*Rhinox
**Added a Synergy with Mixmaster and Waspinator
*Windblade
**Decreased the chance to Stun on her Special Attack 3
*[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]
**Slightly decreased strength of Armor and Melee Buffs
**Signature ability will activate 3 Armor Buffs instead of 1
**Signature ability will activate when at 20% Health instead of 15%
*[[Optimus Prime]]
**Slightly decreased strength of Armor Buffs
*Superconductor Modules
**Moved the Power Gain ability to the Signature Ability
**Power Gain is now distributed constantly over-time instead of all at once
*[[E.M.I. Module]]
**Reduced the projectile flight speed penalty at all Ranks
**Increased the chance to be Unstoppable against a projectile at lower Ranks
**Updating iconography, pause descriptions, and text callouts to more clearly communicate the active effects
*[[Harm Accelerator]] Module
**The basic “Enhanced Degen” ability has been removed
**The Bleed generated by the Module now lasts 60 seconds instead of permanently
**Known Issue: One of the ability descriptions still references “permanent bleed” which is incorrect.
**Bleed damage now scales with the Attack of the defending Bot

=== Version 2.0 ===

'''Release Date: June 14'''
====Official Release Notes====
*Complete your Transformers: The Last Knight experience with new limited-time missions. - Rumors that the Autobot Hot Rod has arrived on New Quintessa enrages Drift who vows to hunt him down. - Perplexed by Drift's vow Optimus Prime and Bumblebee fear that the Decepticon turned Autobot has gone rogue and is resorting back to his old Decepticon ways. Play the all new Spotlight - "A Question of Loyalty" - and find out what happens when brothers in arms do battle.
*Megatron has returned to take his place as the new boss of Alliance Missions!
*New Level Cap! Commanders can now reach Level 50!
*New Daily Login Calendar!
**Great prizes await the faithful Commanders who login everyday!
**Collect Rewards from the 7 Day, 28 Day, and Alliance Calendars.
*Fight in a brand new environment inspired by Transformers: The Last Knight.
*A whole new look for your Base!
**Base updates bring a new level of visual polish and navigational ease.
**Show off up to four Relics with two new sockets added.
**Several new Relics with new effects have been added. New Relics can be found by fully Exploring any difficulty level of "A Question of Loyalty" as well as from the special Event Calendar. These Relics also have new in-game benefits.
*Tip the odds in your favor by using Boosts to augment your Bots' performance.
**Boosts can increase your damage output or survivability.
**Activate an XP Boost to accelerate your level ups and claim rewards faster.
**Some Boosts are only applied to a specific game mode.
*Forging a Module now awards bonus Module Crystal Shards based on the Rank, Level, and Signature Ability Level of the Modules that are consumed.
**1-Star Modules do not award Shards.
**2-Star Modules award 3-Shard Module Crystal Shards.
**3-Star Modules award 4-Star Module Crystal Shards.
*A new Synergy Bonus interface now shows you who is providing a bonus and who is receiving a bonus. The benefits and targets for existing Synergy Bonuses have not changed.
*Several new Synergy Bonuses have been added.
*The Alliance-based currency Loyalty has been removed.
**Existing Loyalty balances have been converted to Gold.
**You now earn Gold for answering Alliance Help Requests.
*Alliance Help requests will now immediately award 3 Energy in addition to the Energy received from Alliance mates.
*Bot Changes
**1-Star and 2-Star Bots now start with two Special Attacks at Rank 1 and unlock a third Special Attack after Ranking Up.
**3-Star Bots now start with three Special Attacks at Rank 1.
**New Synergies have been added and tuned for several bots.
*Mixmaster
**Received a re-design, both on his Basic Abilities and his Signature.
**Updated design will be more in line with other Demolition Bots (Very high damage bursts in a short period of time)
**Acid does not have a cost anymore and Neutralizes Resistances Buffs when active, making him really great against Bots like Ultra Magnus.
**Will deal Burn on his Special 3.
**Whenever opponents have an active Debuff, Mixmaster will get a huge Critical Rate Buff.
*Arcee
**Generates power from Non-Critical Hits.
**Power generation from Critical Hits has been reduced to 12%.
**Guardian's Ferocity now has a 20% increased chance to trigger at all Signature levels.
*Mod Changes
**Laser Guidance and EMI Module
***Module buffs and debuffs can no longer be overridden by projectile buffs from bots.
**A new formula adds a global minimum and maximum speed limit for projectiles to account for bots that might stack Projectile Speed buffs.
*Fight Tuning Adjustments:
**Made Adjustments to the AI of enemies to make them less likely to hold their power until they can use their Special 3
**Tuned down aggression of Enemy AI in harder content
**Made a slight adjustment to the speed of Projectile Attacks to make them easier for players to avoid
**Slightly increased the window to chain from a combo into a special attack
*Bug Fixes and Optimizations
**Fixed an issue with the effectiveness of Module Signature Abilities during Raids
**Stash items now default to sort by expiry
**Filter basic ORE-13 and Catalysts in the Stash and Inventory screens
**Some timers that previously just showed hours now show minutes as well.
**Fixed an issue causing Wins in Arenas showing as a Loss

==== Other Changes ====
*New background for Bots on upgrade and info screens.
*Tier 1 Basic [[Ore-13]] has been removed from the Raid Store.
*The [[Superconductor 1000]] has been removed from the Raid Store.
*1-Star Bots no longer supply Synergy Bonuses.
*Windblade gets an updated small portrait to match her large portrait.
*Mixmaster also receives a redesign in posture.
*Mixmaster no longer has Physical Resistance Buffs.

<center>Date: October 18</center>

==== Official Release Notes ====
*'''Act 3, Chapter 3 is now unlocked! '''
**Megatron's rise to power culminates in this chapter as the Scientist struggles to prove his value to his crazed leader. The Scientist offers his latest creations, further enhancing Megatron's Sharkticons and legion of Transformers to carry out his maniacal ambitions. Can the Commander and his allies remove this terrible foe? Maybe with the help of some new allies...
*'''10 new powerful Masteries are now available!'''
**'''Offensive Masteries:'''
***Glass Cannon: Increases the Attack Rating of all your Bots, but lowers their maximum Health
***Double Edge: Increases the Attack Rating of all your Bots, but they suffer a Bleed Debuff every fight
***Despair: Enemies Repair less Health for each Debuff they're suffering from
***Suppression: Enemies suffering Stun trigger fewer abilities and Repair less Health
***Stupefy: When your Bots inflict Stun, it lasts longer
***Deep Wounds: When your Bots inflict Bleed Debuffs, they last longer and deal extra damage
**'''Defensive Masteries: '''
***Bleed Resistance: Any Bleed Damage your Bots would take is reduced
***Shock Resistance: Any Shock Damage your Bots would take, such as Shock Debuffs, is reduced
***Silica Plating: Any Heat Damage your Bots would take, such as Burn Debuffs, is reduced
***Inhibitor: Enemies suffering from Shock or Stun generate less Power
*'''New Features!'''
**Awakening Programs have been added, providing a way to activate a Bot signature ability without duplicating it.
**Signature Upgrades have been added, allowing the upgrading of a signature ability of an already awakened Bot. A Signature Upgrade will add to the Bot's Signature Ability level.
*'''Improvements & Fixes'''
**Bot statistics that increase from Upgrading and Forging are showcased more clearly
**Alliance Missions will initially provide a recommended Map and Difficulty based on your Alliance
**Editing the Alliance objective or description now supports changing the existing text
**Tapping on a Relic during a raid will display additional about it
**Added a setting to refresh ‘don’t show again’ popups
**The Fight menu has been updated to better showcase relevant Missions
**The Spark inventory now default sorts by class, and has new filter options for Mod and Alpha sparks
**The Daily mission banner will update to showcase the relevant class each day
**Tapping a player’s name on the Raid leaderboard will display their Commander profile
**Clarification for what fight round of an Arena series you are in
**Crashing during loading into Raids or Mission fights will no longer apply a health penalty
**Fixed an issue that caused extra Bots to appear in combat
**Fixed a delay when Ramjet fires his Special 1 attack, along with other related delays
**Crash fixes and optimizations

==== Other changes ====
* Ramjet's portrait images are updated.

== 2018 Updates ==

=== Version 5.0 ===
[[File:TF_F2F_splashscreen_homepage_EN-1_5.0.png|center|thumb|400px]]
<center>'''Launch Date: '''January 10'''</center>
==== New Features ====
*'''Rewarded Advertisements are coming to Forged to Fight'''
**5.0 will add new optional Advertisement functionality in game. These advertisements are totally opt in, and provide rewards like Energon and Energy! This means that you will never see an advertisement if you don’t want to, and will get something just for watching an advertisement!
**Every day, you will be able to watch 3 Ads (accessible from your Base screen) in exchange for 5 Energon each. This timer will reset every day at Midnight UTC. You’ll also be able to watch an Advertisement upon running out of Energy in a mission to gain 9 more energy. You will be able to do this once every 6 hours.
**There may be times out of our control when advertisements are not available for viewing. When there are no available advertisements, the button will appear as grey, and not able to be interacted with. Check back later, they may be available later!
**We want to reiterate that these are completely optional, and it is up to you whether you would like to interact with them or not!

*'''Use Stash Ore-13 Directly from the Upgrade Screen!'''
**If there is room in your Inventory, you can now use your stashed Ore-13 directly from your Upgrade Screen

*'''Bot Updates'''
**Increased Ultra Magnus's chance to Nullify to 100% to match his Ability Description

*'''Features'''
**The Treasury has been removed as all Alliance Missions are now free to enter.
**Bots that are available, but unowned, are now shown in the Bots menu.
**Bot portraits have been touched up and their backgrounds are colored to reflect their class.
**Class advantage and disadvantage is now shown in combat. (Bug: except in Arenas)
**Rarity is now shown when opening awakening and signature items from crystals.
**Ranged attacks from a KO’d Bot no longer deal damage.

==== Bug Fixes ====
**Fixed a rare issue that would cause the loading screen to display over a fight.
**Fixed an issue on the prefight screen where Bot Stats were missing and the selected Bot couldn’t be changed.
**Fixed unnecessary gaps in information on certain panels and popups.
**Fixed a visual issue with reflected projectiles.
**Fixed an issue with Optimus Primal’s heavy attack range being too short.
**Fixed two causes of gameplay framerate hitches.
**Performance optimizations, localization updates, and bug fixes.
**Fixed an Issue where Bumblebee was not counting as an Autobot in Synergies
**Fixed an issue with the Beast Purification Synergy causing it not to activate with all Beast Wars Characters

=== Version 5.1 ===
<center>'''Release:''' January 31</center>
==== New Features ====
*Act 3 Chapter 4 Is Now Waiting for You to Explore! 
**The final chapter of Act 3 arrives! With The Quintessons in self-exile and a Megatron mysteriously vanished, Shockwave prepares for the return of the true Megatron...his Megatron. New Quintessa's secrets begin to be uncovered revealing signs of ancient inhabitants long dead. Or are they?
*Bots Updates
**Updates to the abilities of Arcee, Ultra Magnus, Ramjet, Dinobot, Shockwave, Sidewipe and Galvatron to further improve their performance in-game! Check out [http://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/3739/upcoming-bot-changes-january-31st-updated| this thread] for all of the details!

*Optimization And Bug Fixes: 
**Optimized combat to remove some spikes in performance and framerate.
**Greatly reduced the amount of downloaded data when updating from an older version.
**Fixed some memory leaks, increasing overall stability.
**Class advantage is now properly displayed in arena fights.
**Fixed a sorting issue in the Spark inventory screen.
**Fixed an issue where the Act cutscenes images wouldn’t display properly.
**Fixed a display issue with Mission completion rewards where it would just show gold, although you were actually earning Energon and ORE-13 as well.
**Fixed a number of PI display inconsistencies.
**Fixed a combat issue where a dash would miss after landing a ranged attack when the opponent was against a wall.

=== Version 5.2 ===
<center>'''Release:''' March 7</center>
==== New Features ====
*Features:
**Drop rates will be displayed when purchasing Crystals with any currency.
**When viewing a Crystal, tap the info icon to view the drop rates. For more information, check out [http://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/4113/drop-rate-information-in-the-fight| this Post].
**The damage from the last hit in combat is now (re)displayed.
**The base has been re-lit to brighten it and help visibility.
**Improved presentation of popups and their background blur effects.
**Tapping an Alliance on the Alliance Mission results will now load their profile.
**Ancient Sanctum has been set to night to help with path visibility.
*Bug fixes:
**Fixed two character memory leaks, substantially improving stability on 1GB memory devices.
**Fixed an issue where notifications could cause the game to crash while minimized.
**Fixed a hang in combat when receiving Alliance help.
**Fixed an issue that could cause pause functionality to not work properly.
**Fixed issues with certain special bright attack effects appearing corrupted.
**Fixed an overlap issue when viewing Bot info during Alliance Missions.
**Optimus Primal and Ramjet’s special 2 should now successfully land after a combo.
**Localization and text updates.
*Bot Update
**Ultra Magnus will no longer receive the Attack Bonus from his Signature Ability while alone. He will still gain the bonus to Physical Resistance. This should mostly only affect the AI, and should make him an easier encounter in the wild.

=== Version 6.0 ===
[[File:TFF v6.0-Splash-Screen.png|center|400px]]
{{quotes|Celebrate TRANSFORMERS: Forged to Fight 1-year anniversary with this exciting new update! Log in and enjoy a limited-time Boost and Event Calendar to celebrate with us! For the Commanders who have been with us since the beginning, log in to get an exclusive Anniversary Relic.}}

***Lifetime objectives provide great rewards for achievements.
***Other limited-time objective sets may appear during events.
**5-Stars Bots are now available! Start collecting 5-Star shards throughout the game to earn one.

**Assassin grants bonus attack and reduced ability triggers to enemies below 18% Health

***Earn 3-Star shards when collecting a 2-Star
***Earn 4-Star shards when collecting a 3-Star

**In combat, the health bar frame now indicates Bot rarity.
**In combat, the health bars have been widened.

**Fixed an alignment issue between the Boost and Class Wheel on the questboard.
**Fixed an issue with ‘Find New Opponent’ in Raids sometimes giving the previous opponent.
**Fixes for typos and grammatical errors.
**Optimizations and memory leak fixes.

8.0 rebalanced a whole ton of Bots, including:

HOUND
*Added +3.6% to base Critical Rate.

*Increased Signature Ability scaling to start at +50% projectile damage. This scales to an unchanged maximum of +200%.
*The bonus from Hound’s Signature Ability remains activate during Special Attacks that activated before the bonus expired.
*Increase Critical Damage against Burning opponents.
*The Critical Resistance Debuff now scales up, gaining +0.5s duration and -1.8% potency each Rank.
*The increased Critical Damage against Burning targets now scales up +5% with each Rank.
*The final (grenade) hit of Special 2 inflicts Burn instead of Bleed.
*Sidestepping while Precision Ammo is equipped Purifies Dazed effects.
*Added +10% Attack to Inferno Ammo heat damage at all Ranks and now all damage is dealt after 10s instead of 15s.

MIXMASTER
*The chance to trigger an Acid Debuff on projectile attacks starts with +5% chance and scales up an additional +5% with each Rank, up to a maximum of 50% at Rank 5.
*The Acid Debuff from projectile attacks lasts +1 second longer at all Ranks.
*Added +10% Attack to Acid Damage from projectile attacks at all Ranks.
*Added +8% base Block Proficiency.
''Acid is one of the unique aspects of Mixmaster but wasn’t relevant enough in most fights. These changes make it more worthwhile and reliable to leverage ranged gameplay to generate this unique effect.''

JETFIRE
*Added +3% to base Attack.
*Added +5% to base Block Proficiency.
*Increased the duration of his Ranged Bonus from 10s to 20s.
*The Old Friends Synergy with Starscream is now part of Jetfire’s base kit; however, the Stun from well-timed Blocks no longer affects Special Attacks and the Stun duration has been shortened to 1s. The Synergy still exists, but has the new effect of increasing the duration of this Stun from well-timed Blocks by 50%.
''It was never intended to let any Bot inflict Stun to an enemy during that enemies’ Special animation. This has led to several issues, and breaks a rule of gameplay in an uncomfortable way. This Synergy with Starscream was so potent that it made Jetfire feel reliant on a specific team. We’ve kept a Synergy between them, but Jetfire is now more viable on non-Starscream teams.''

KICKBACK
*Added +3.6% base Critical Rate.
*Added +10% base Critical Damage.
*Special 2 Critical (blade) hits now inflict Bleed.

STARSCREAM
*Special 1 chance for a Projectile Damage Buff increased to 100%.
*Projectile Bonus duration increased by 2 seconds.
*Special 2 Armor Break now has a chance to trigger on both hits and lasts 2 seconds longer.
*Starscream’s Old Friends Synergy with Jetfire no longer plays a Sidestep animation to avoid projectiles when Starscream dashes back. Instead, projectiles miss. He still receives the Critical Damage Buff when a projectile misses during his Dodge.
''The extra hit of Armor Break is an additional chance to remove an enemy Armor Up. This Armor Break is now more in line with what to expect from a Special 2, and from a Tactician Bot.''

GALVATRON
*Increased the chance to trigger a Dark Burn from Heavy Attacks by 0.7% per charge of Dark Energy.
At 30 charges, the chance to trigger a Dark Burn is 51%, up from the previous 30%.
*Added 10% Attack to Dark Burn damage at all Ranks.

GRIMLOCK
*The Purify from his Signature Ability activates after 1 second, down from 1.5 seconds.

GRINDOR
*Special 3 Critical (missile) Hits inflict Burn like other missile attacks.

SIDESWIPE
*Added +3.6% to base Critical Rate.
*Added +10% to base Critical Damage.
*Special 2 chance to Burn increased to 100%.

DINOBOT
*Increased all Critical Rating Buff durations by 2 seconds.
*Increased all Armor Break durations by 2 seconds.
*Added +10% chance to Special 1 Armor Break at all Ranks.
*Added +5% base Block Proficiency.
*Increased Signature Ability scaling to 15...50% chance of Unblockable.

BUMBLEBEE (DARK OF THE MOON)

MEGATRONUS

*The increased Critical Damage against Burning targets now scales up +5% with each Rank.
*The final (grenade) hit of Special 2 inflicts Burn instead of Bleed.
*Sidestepping while Precision Ammo is equipped Purifies Dazed effects.
*Added +10% Attack to Inferno Ammo heat damage at all Ranks and now all damage is dealt after 10s instead of 15s.

MIXMASTER
*The chance to trigger an Acid Debuff on projectile attacks starts with +5% chance and scales up an additional +5% with each Rank, up to a maximum of 50% at Rank 5.
*The Acid Debuff from projectile attacks lasts +1 second longer at all Ranks.
*Added +10% Attack to Acid Damage from projectile attacks at all Ranks.
*Added +8% base Block Proficiency.
''Acid is one of the unique aspects of Mixmaster but wasn’t relevant enough in most fights. These changes make it more worthwhile and reliable to leverage ranged gameplay to generate this unique effect.''

JETFIRE
*Added +3% to base Attack.
*Added +5% to base Block Proficiency.
*Increased the duration of his Ranged Bonus from 10s to 20s.
*The Old Friends Synergy with Starscream is now part of Jetfire’s base kit; however, the Stun from well-timed Blocks no longer affects Special Attacks and the Stun duration has been shortened to 1s. The Synergy still exists, but has the new effect of increasing the duration of this Stun from well-timed Blocks by 50%.
''It was never intended to let any Bot inflict Stun to an enemy during that enemies’ Special animation. This has led to several issues, and breaks a rule of gameplay in an uncomfortable way. This Synergy with Starscream was so potent that it made Jetfire feel reliant on a specific team. We’ve kept a Synergy between them, but Jetfire is now more viable on non-Starscream teams.''

KICKBACK
*Added +3.6% base Critical Rate.
*Added +10% base Critical Damage.
*Special 2 Critical (blade) hits now inflict Bleed.

STARSCREAM
*Special 1 chance for a Projectile Damage Buff increased to 100%.
*Projectile Bonus duration increased by 2 seconds.
*Special 2 Armor Break now has a chance to trigger on both hits and lasts 2 seconds longer.
*Starscream’s Old Friends Synergy with Jetfire no longer plays a Sidestep animation to avoid projectiles when Starscream dashes back. Instead, projectiles miss. He still receives the Critical Damage Buff when a projectile misses during his Dodge.
''The extra hit of Armor Break is an additional chance to remove an enemy Armor Up. This Armor Break is now more in line with what to expect from a Special 2, and from a Tactician Bot.''

GALVATRON
*Increased the chance to trigger a Dark Burn from Heavy Attacks by 0.7% per charge of Dark Energy.
At 30 charges, the chance to trigger a Dark Burn is 51%, up from the previous 30%.
*Added 10% Attack to Dark Burn damage at all Ranks.

GRIMLOCK
*The Purify from his Signature Ability activates after 1 second, down from 1.5 seconds.

GRINDOR
*Special 3 Critical (missile) Hits inflict Burn like other missile attacks.

SIDESWIPE
*Added +3.6% to base Critical Rate.
*Added +10% to base Critical Damage.
*Special 2 chance to Burn increased to 100%.

DINOBOT
*Increased all Critical Rating Buff durations by 2 seconds.
*Increased all Armor Break durations by 2 seconds.
*Added +10% chance to Special 1 Armor Break at all Ranks.
*Added +5% base Block Proficiency.
*Increased Signature Ability scaling to 15...50% chance of Unblockable.

BUMBLEBEE (DARK OF THE MOON)
*Special 1 now has a 40..60% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff on each hit based on Rank.

MEGATRONUS
*Removed 2% base Health.
*Removed 4% base Attack.
''We recognize Megatronus as one of the most effective Bots. We don't want to dethrone him, especially after many of you have worked hard to acquire and upgrade him. We've reduced his overall effectiveness a bit by targeting his core stats, which ensure none of his unique functionality is compromised.''

SHIELDMASTERS SYNERGY
*The Power Steal from well-timed Blocks increased to 2...8% based on Tier.
*Updated to actually subtract Power from the opponent by an equal amount.
